day_focus: Balance the fit20 shift with a steady hand on your systems, ensuring the machinery of the home serves the people in it.
checkin: It's Tactical Tuesday, son; keep your eyes on the horizon and don't let the process become the master. Work hard at the gym, but remember that the most important systems you'll ever build are the ones that make Maria and the kids feel seen and secure. Walk slow, breathe deep, and lead from a place of rest today.
